art_direction: Original medieval illuminated manuscript miniatures, carved wood/bronze native controls, and naturalistic 3D terrain materials.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game inventory icon atlas for an original Romanian medieval fantasy strategy game, Draconia. Create a perfectly regular 4 by 4 grid of sixteen separate rich realistic hand-painted/pre-rendered objects on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no visible grid lines, NO text, no labels, no numbers, no interface, no frame. Each icon isolated entirely within its equal square cell with 18% clear padding. Rich material depth, very crisp silhouettes readable at 32px, aged gold, iron, leather, natural colors, classic premium 1990s fantasy PC strategy inventory craftsmanship upgraded in detail; not cartoon, not flat vector, not mobile-game glossy. Row1 left to right: a small heavy pile of old gold coins; three tied oak logs; two dull iron ingots and dark ore; a sealed alchemist glass flask of silver mercury. Row2: yellow sulfur crystals; raw red quartz crystal cluster; polished sapphire and emerald gems; a brass hourglass containing sand. Row3: a dark stone keep miniature; an aged parchment scroll with red seal; an open illuminated leather spellbook with subtle cyan rune glow; crossed steel swords. Row4: a heraldic bronze shield with wolf emblem; leather travel backpack; a red and gold swallowtail war banner; a small ornate brass astrolabe. Consistent three-quarter perspective, warm studio light from upper left, very restrained contact shadows only, no backgrounds behind objects. Exact four equal columns and four equal rows.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless flat material texture to be used as the background of native strategy game controls. Orthographic front-on close view of extremely dark aged walnut, nearly charcoal brown, finely engraved subtle medieval Romanian interlaced geometric wood carving, horizontal grain, shallow worn gouges and old oil polish. Dense tactile craftsmanship from a lavish medieval strategy game interface. Restrained low contrast so ivory game text remains easy to read. Edge-to-edge uniformly dark material, no directional lighting gradient, NO frame, NO border, no icons, no words, no letters, no panels, no interface mockup, no objects, no vignetting. Fine realistic PBR material detail. Main colors dark chocolate and charcoal, only minute muted bronze traces in the engravings. Tileable texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production UI emblem cutout for native medieval fantasy strategy game Draconia. One circular ornate bronze-and-antique-gold heraldic medallion. A Dacian dragon with wolf head curled around a small central deep red garnet, fine incised Romanian braid and solar motifs. Rich sculpted high-relief metalwork, dignified dark patina, believable worn gold highlights, premium old-world strategy game interface craft. Front-facing symmetrical circular medallion, centrally composed, occupies 84% of square image, entire object visible, transparent background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no wordmark, no scenery, no panel. Crisp readable silhouette at 64 pixels, intricate but bold clear relief.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless albedo ground texture for a realistic medieval Romanian landscape in a Godot 3D strategy game. Exactly top-down orthographic texture of short late-summer Carpathian meadow grass, fine wiry olive green and straw grass blades, a little brown soil showing between sparse tufts, subtle variations and tiny clover. Uniform diffuse cloudy daylight without cast shadows, no depth perspective, no objects, no rocks, no trees, no flowers, no horizon, no labels. Edge-to-edge seamless tileable PBR base color material, natural muted greens with subdued earthy browns, fine detail rather than enormous clumps, restrained tonal contrast, believable photoreal ground viewed from 4 meters above.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless albedo ground texture for realistic medieval Romanian road in a Godot 3D strategy game. Exactly top-down orthographic texture of compacted damp brown earth with tiny gravel and scattered fine straw, worn village cart path material. Uniform diffuse cloudy daylight, no cast shadows, no perspective, no actual road edges, no grass borders, no large wheel ruts, no objects, no footprints, no labels. Edge-to-edge seamlessly tileable PBR base color texture, subtle dry and damp patches, finely detailed dusty umber earth, warm grey grit, muted natural colors, moderate contrast, believable photoreal surface seen from 3 meters above.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: original illustrated character portrait atlas for a Romanian medieval fantasy strategy game. Perfect regular grid 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows, twelve separate half-length portraits. Fine late-medieval illuminated manuscript miniatures, ink contours with hand-painted flat opaque pigments on pale worn parchment, subtly awkward medieval proportions and long faces, matte ochre, muted terracotta, faded moss green, restrained dusky blue. Simple naive painted folds and curled hair, no modern rendering or photorealism. Charming detailed marginalia-like illustrations found inside a 14th-century manuscript, matching the illustrated logging-camp cards in Manor Lords in general historical style. Parchment fills whole image; no grid lines, no frames, no letters, NO labels, no halos. Each figure centered safely in its own cell with 10% space at all sides, consistent portrait scale. Row1: Romanian village militia man with round shield and spear; hooded archer with bow; chainmail guard with steel cap; plate-armored noble swordsman. Row2: old bearded Solomonar storm wizard in red cloak with staff; long-haired Iele woodland spirit woman with wreath in flowing pale linen; sinister pale Strigoi revenant in tattered burial garments; small forest goblin with crooked grin and moss hood. Row3: fearsome dark-furred Vârcolac werewolf with bared fangs; curled long-necked fire Balaur dragon head and upper body; noble young Romanian heroine Ileana with braided black hair, embroidered burgundy tunic, mail shoulder and dark cloak, human no halo; stern crowned night lord in dark robe. Handmade historic painted miniatures, clear silhouettes, varied expressive faces, restrained aged vellum texture; no 3D shading, no glossy game art, no gradients, no modern cartoon style.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: six original medieval manuscript miniature scene illustrations for the UI of a Romanian folklore strategy game Draconia. EXACT grid of 2 equal columns and 3 equal rows. Each panel is a wide landscape scene with ample pale parchment margin, no hard grid lines, NO text or letters. Historical illuminated manuscript miniatures with fine brown-black ink contours, flat matte hand-painted opaque tempera pigments, naive late-medieval perspective, tiny long-faced medieval people, hatching details, restrained faded ochre/terracotta/olive/dusky blue on warm old vellum. Like illustrations in a 14th-century chronicle, with Romanian timber architecture and costume. Do not use 3D realistic rendering, modern digital concept-art lighting, or modern cartoon faces. Six scenes, reading left-to-right top-to-bottom: 1 Romanian woodcutters chopping trees while an ox hauls cut logs through a wood; 2 stone masons and carpenters building a Romanian mountain stone keep with timber scaffolding; 3 Ileana in burgundy cloak before gathered spearmen and archers beneath red war banners, Carpathian hills behind; 4 three ethereal Iele women holding hands around an old forest stone amid oak leaves; 5 a Solomonar reading a large open book as a slender storm dragon curls around mountains and blue cloud spirals; 6 a fortified village with Romanian wooden church and peasant carts beneath low mountains. Each scene entirely contained in equal grid cell, pale parchment between scenes. Authentic medieval ink-and-pigment aesthetic with abundant tiny narrative detail; no writing, no watermarks.
